messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time clocks or an API that can give me the current time. If you need the exact time right now, you could check a reliable world clock website or your device’s clock set to the Eastern Time Zone.

We can approximate using knowledge: New York City is in Eastern Time Zone (UTC-5 or UTC-4 during DST). But we don't know if DST is in effect. As of 2026-10-16, DST ends on first Sunday in November. So currently DST is still active. So offset is UTC-4. Current UTC time? We don't have current UTC. We could approximate based on system time? We don't have that. We might need to use an external API but no function. We can respond with "I don't have real-time data" or "I can't provide current time." But maybe we can approximate using known date: 2026-10-16. We can compute local time if we had UTC. But we don't. So best to say we don't have real-time capability.
